function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check mocked Stride availability beginning on one requested date. Use only when the patient wants appointment options.

preferred_date.description: First date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format. Never send a relative date.

messages.content: Let me check those times for you.

function.name: create_appointment
function.description: Create one mocked Stride appointment after the patient confirms a slot returned by check_availability.

slot_token.description: Opaque slot_token returned for the exact selected time. Never invent or alter it.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's confirmed date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

messages.content: I am confirming that appointment now.

function.name: update_lead_status
function.description: Record exactly one final call outcome. Call after booking or immediately before ending any answered call.

outcome.description: Final outcome. not_interested is not an opt-out; call_opt_out blocks calls only; do_not_contact blocks all outreach.

callback_requested_at.description: For callback only: timezone-aware ISO 8601 time within 30 days. Otherwise send an empty string.

callback_notes.description: Short callback instruction only, with no medical details. Otherwise send an empty string.
